record.notes: The markup is 7x on 30 days, 5.6x on 90 days and 5.6x on 180 days. A voucher is not automatically a small premium: at this reseller it is the difference between affordable and not. Vendor baseline, third-party: comparative listings lists Real-Debrid at EUR 3 / 15 days, EUR 4 / 30 days, EUR 9 / 90 days, EUR 16 / 180 days. real-debrid.com/premium returned 403 to read (exa, browserless, contextdev) and to fetch, so the vendor's own table was not read on 2026-10-23. At EUR 28 for 30 days this shop is 7x the vendor's own 30-day price; the 360-day SKU at EUR 99 is 3.1x the sum of two 180-day purchases (EUR 32). The 360-day term is the one thing a reseller sells that the vendor's published table does not. No programmatic path found: web store; delivery is a code redeemed at the vendor
